JLL is seeking a talented and motivated Full Stack Developer 2 (P2) to join our Workplace Digital Technology (WDT) team. As a Full Stack Developer 2, you will be responsible for designing, developing, testing, and maintaining scalable web applications that support JLL's digital workplace platforms — working across both the front end and back end using React, Java, and microservices-based architectures. You will work closely with product owners, architects, and cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality features while contributing to long-term code health and technical excellence. Key Responsibilities Design and develop responsive, high-performance user interfaces using React (Hooks, Context/Redux, TypeScript preferred) Design, build, and maintain backend services and RESTful APIs using Java, with hands-on experience in Spring Boot Design and implement microservices, ensuring scalability, resilience, and maintainability across distributed systems Write clean, testable, and maintainable code with comprehensive unit, integration, and end-to-end tests Collaborate with product and design teams to translate business requirements into robust technical solutions Participate in agile ceremonies (sprint planning, stand-ups, retrospectives) and contribute to continuous improvement Champion “shift-left” quality practices by embedding testing early in the development lifecycle Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve production issues across both front-end and back-end components in a timely manner Contribute to documentation, code reviews, and knowledge sharing within the engineering team Adhere to JLL's security, compliance, and operational standards Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience) 3–6 years of professional software development experience as a full stack developer Strong front-end development experience using React (or similar modern frameworks such as Angular, Next.js) Strong back-end development experience using Java, including hands-on work with Spring Boot Experience designing and consuming RESTful APIs, and building and maintaining microservices architectures Experience with relational or NoSQL databases and data modeling Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, version control (Git), and cloud platforms (Azure preferred) Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced, distributed team environment with excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail Experience with AI agents and integrating AI/ML capabilities into applications is a plus Why Join JLL? Be part of a global leader in real estate and facility services with a strong digital transformation agenda Work on impactful products that shape the future of workplace experience Collaborate with diverse, international teams across time zones Access to professional development, mentorship, and career growth opportunities Show more Show less Seniority level Associate Employment type Full-time Job function Engineering and Information Technology Industries Real Estate Referrals increase your chances of interviewing at JLL by 2x See who you know

It is the largest managed health care company in the Blue Cross Blue Shield (BCBS) Association serving more than 112 million individuals across 14 states. A regular in Fortune 500 list, Elevance Health ranked 18 in 2026. Gail Boudreaux, President and CEO of Elevance Health has been a consistent name in the Fortune list of most powerful women and currently holds 81st rank on this list. About Carelon Global Solutions Carelon Global Solutions (CGS) is a healthcare solutions company simplifying complex operational processes to improve the health of the healthcare system. Previously known as Legato Health Technologies, Carelon Global Solutions (hereinafter, CGS) underwent a name change and joined the Carelon family of brands in January 2023, as a fully owned subsidiary of Elevance Health (Previously Anthem Inc.). CGS brings together a global team of like-minded innovators who manage and optimize operational processes for health plans as well as providers. Our brightest minds housed across our global headquarters in Indianapolis as well as Bengaluru, Hyderabad and Gurugram in India, Manila in the Philippines, and San Juan in Puerto Rico bring with them innovative capabilities and an unmatched depth of experience. This global team uniquely positions CGS to enable scalable, next-generation platforms and specialized digital tools that make healthcare operations more practical, effective, and efficient. OUR MISSION & VALUES Our Mission: Improving Lives and Communities. Simplifying Healthcare. Expecting More. Our Values: Leadership | Community | Integrity | Agility | Diversity Job Purpose Carelon Global Solutions India is seeking for a Software Engineer II. CIP creates Actionable Clinical Intelligence required for Anthem Care Management, Disease Management, Patient Safety and Integrated Contracting capabilities JOB RESPONSIBILITY Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend services using Java and Spring Boot. Work on CI/CD deployment pipeline creations and improvements. QUALIFICATION B. TECH/MCA/MS Experience 2-5 years of hands-on experience in Snowflake and AWS. Strong proficiency in Java 8/11/17. Hands on experience in Spring Boot, Spring Security and Spring JPA Microservices architecture and REST API development Strong experience in React.js, JavaScript, TypeScript. Skills And Competencies 2-5 years of hands-on experience in Snowflake and AWS. Strong proficiency in Java 8/11/17. Description As a Software Development Engineer on the Everyday Essentials Promotions (EEP) team, you'll build systems that power promotional experiences for millions of Amazon customers. Our platform determines which promotions customers see, manages discount optimization through ML driven recommendations, and processes billions of dollars in promotional spend across multiple marketplaces. You'll work across a full stack system spanning React frontends, Java/Spring backend services, DynamoDB, SQS based async processing, and ML integration pipelines, all operating at Amazon retail scale. We're looking for engineers who are comfortable owning ambiguous problems end to end, can design systems that balance correctness with performance, and thrive in a team that ships frequently to production. Key job responsibilities Design and implement distributed backend services processing promotional configurations at scale Build and maintain React based portal experiences used by internal business stakeholders Own features end to end: from design through implementation, testing, deployment, and operational excellence Drive engineering best practices including code quality, testing strategy, and operational readiness Collaborate with science teams on ML recommendation pipelines and data driven optimization Participate in on call rotation and drive improvements to system reliability Basic Qualifications 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience Experience programming with at least one software programming language Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent Preferred Qualifications 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience Knowledge of Machine Learning and LLM fundamentals, including transformer architecture, training/inference lifecycles, and optimization techniques Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers.
